name: Default
shortDescription: Real-time messaging server that delivers published messages to subscribed clients over WebSocket, SSE and HTTP-streaming, with an HTTP API and an admin web UI.

alerts.message: Sign in to the admin UI with the generated CENTRIFUGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Your backend publishes through the HTTP API at /api with the X-API-Key header set to CENTRIFUGO_HTTP_API_KEY, and signs client connection JWTs with CENTRIFUGO_CLIENT_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET_KEY.
Browser clients are rejected unless their origin is listed. Add your application's origins, space separated, to CENTRIFUGO_CLIENT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
